blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan — An eight-year-old boy drowned in a lake in Umingan, Pangasinan, after rushing to save his younger brother, who had cried for help while they were swimming after school on Wednesday, Sept. 30. According to a police report, the brothers were on their way home from school when they decided to stop and swim in the lake. What began as an ordinary swim ended in tragedy when the younger brother suddenly struggled in the water.
